title: Claude in Google Docs, Sheets & Slides: 3 Useful Tricks + Paid Catch
description:
Claude can now work inside Google Docs, Google Sheets and Google Slides through an official Anthropic Workspace add-on. This practical explainer shows three FICTIONAL examples: a Sheets VLOOKUP returning #N/A, a long Docs proposal that needs cleaning up, and a crowded Slides presentation. Also: who gets beta access, how to install it and which approvals matter.

This video uses illustrative visual mockups and is not a live test of Anthropic's add-on. Anthropic says the feature is beta on Claude Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans; an approved Google Marketplace installation is also necessary. The add-on works with the file you have open rather than automatically accessing your entire Drive. Changes are recorded in version history. Chart images in Slides are not dynamically linked to Sheets. Double-check any AI formula or document change.

Official Anthropic guide: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16951679-use-claude-in-google-docs-sheets-and-slides
Announcement: https://claude.com/resources/articles/claude-now-works-in-google-docs-sheets-and-slides
Official Marketplace listing: https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/claude/12459801340

Original animations, illustrative browser/file UI, licensed existing Pexels photo frames: https://www.pexels.com/video/close-up-on-man-hands-using-phone-10374885/ .
